_comment: RUNE_GATE_FLAG was set by nothing, and it gated a STATIC ability, which maps to no event and never runs -- so the +3 was doubly dead. Rune Gate (CR 8.3.27) is now a real keyword: a card declaring it is offered from the banished zone, free, when its controller has Runechants >= its {r} cost, and 8.3.27a marks the card and the player as having rune gated. 'The NEXT attack action card you rune gate' is a one-shot on the next matching attack, not a turn-long static -- as a static it would buff every rune-gated attack for the rest of the turn.
